title: 8.2.2. Suttantacittamissakavisesa
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Yassa sarāgaṁ cittaṁ uppajjati na nirujjhati tassa sarāgaṁ cittaṁ nirujjhissati na uppajjissatīti?
Sarāgapacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṁ sarāgaṁ cittaṁ uppajjati na nirujjhati, nirujjhissati na uppajjissati. Itaresaṁ sarāgacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṁ …pe….
